poll

DURATION: How long the poll runs, like 30m, 2h or 3d (1 day by default)
MULTIPLE_OPTION: Allow picking more than one answer
HIDDEN_OPTION: Show the results only after the poll ends
QUESTION: Question
BAD_DURATION: The duration must be from 1 minute to 30 days, like 30m, 2h or 3d
BAD_OPTIONS: A poll needs 2 to {{max}} different answers, each up to {{length}} characters
AUTHOR: By {{user}}
CANT_END: Only the author or someone who can manage messages can end this poll
VOTERS_HIDDEN: Voters are hidden in this poll
RESULT: 📊 {{user}}, your poll **{{question}}** has ended. The winner is {{winner}} with {{count}} {{votes}} ({{percent}}%)
RESULT_TIE: 📊 {{user}}, your poll **{{question}}** has ended in a tie between {{winner}}, {{count}} {{votes}} each ({{percent}}%)
RESULT_EMPTY: 📊 {{user}}, your poll **{{question}}** has ended, but nobody voted
